title: jev-screen sieve author draft
description: What an AI agent may write into an idea's sieve with `jevscreen sieve new|set --from DRAFT`. The draft is a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) of these author fields only: a null value removes a field, objects merge, lists replace. Everything else in the sieve (card answers, pins, rules, keyword learning, `resolved`, idea_en_reprice) is written by the tool. Pins need the human's own yes: `jevscreen sieve pin`. Kept in sync with jevscreen.sieve_author (tests/test_cli_why.py).

idea.description: The exact idea text (after trimming spaces) the sieve belongs to. A draft whose idea differs from the sieve's is refused.

idea_en.description: English rendering of a non-English idea, used in the Jev questions instead of the local model's. Ignored for an English idea or another idea's sieve; frozen once a paid run of the idea used another one (sieve set --reprice, human's yes). Must not name a company the sieve lists.

seed_terms.description: Excerpt keyword terms per annual-report language, used after the user's --keywords flags and before generated terms.

facets.description: English slots the library rules are rendered with: category and target are required when facets is set; mechanism is optional.

facets_zh.description: The same slots in Chinese, for the cards and the report only (never sent to Jev).

target_terms.description: Terms naming the idea's object, per language (used by the scope card).

should_pass.description: 应该有（检查）: companies the human expects in the list. Always read by layer 2 and reported; never pinned. Resolved once, when written (ticker, exchange code, security id or exact name).

should_fail.description: 不该有（检查）: companies the human expects NOT to be in the list. Same rules as should_pass; a company may not be in both.

notes.description: Free notes for the human; never sent to Jev.

examples.idea: 人形机器人：给工厂和仓库用的双足或轮式人形机器人及其关键零部件
examples.idea_en: Humanoid robots for factories and warehouses, and their key components
examples.notes: drafted by the agent after the first dry run
